en-US.DESC_TILEARC_ENABLE: Rounds the outer corner of every turn, not just the 90°–105° band the game rounds by default. Applies to tiles already on screen straight away.
en-US.DESC_TILEARC_INTENSITY: How far the rounded corner reaches, as a percentage of the tile's width. 100% is a full half-circle corner; 0% leaves the turn sharp.
